records.context: the cycle numbers the stack holds, ascending. The reference cycle is always among them.

records.translation: hringnúmerin sem staflinn geymir, í vaxandi röð. Viðmiðunarhringurinn er alltaf á meðal þeirra.

records.translation: hringir þar sem skráning gagnvart viðmiðuninni var ekki samþykkt. Þeim er haldið utan staflans, því basar sem lesnir eru á ótraustum hnitum afkóðast í rangt strikamerki frekar en ekkert.

records.context: ``cycle -> (dy, dx)``, the shift that moved each kept cycle onto the reference; the reference's own is ``(0, 0)``.

records.source: ``(cycle, channel)`` pairs whose within-cycle registration was refused and which were therefore not moved.
records.translation: ``(cycle, channel)`` pör þar sem skráningu innan hrings var hafnað og sem því voru ekki færð.

records.context: Register one microscope field of view's channels within each cycle, then its cycles.
records.label: spacr.ops_cycles.align_field#0
records.source: Register one field's channels within each cycle, then its cycles.
records.translation: Skráir rásir eins sviðs innan hvers hrings og síðan hringi þess.

records.context: Each base image data channel is first moved onto its cycle's first image data channel, on the clipped cell background the image data channels share -- on the measured laboratory microplate they sat up to 14 px apart, which no cycle-to-cycle registration can see -- and each cycle is then moved onto the reference with :func:`sbs_mean_target`. A cycle offered as ``None`` or with a missing image layer is reported in :attr:`AlignedField.missing` and one whose registration is refused in :attr:`AlignedField.refused`; the rest are still aligned, so one lost cycle does not cost the microscope field of view.
records.label: spacr.ops_cycles.align_field#1
records.source: Each base channel is first moved onto its cycle's first channel, on the clipped cell background the channels share -- on the measured plate they sat up to 14 px apart, which no cycle-to-cycle registration can see -- and each cycle is then moved onto the reference with :func:`sbs_mean_target`. A cycle offered as ``None`` or with a missing plane is reported in :attr:`AlignedField.missing` and one whose registration is refused in :attr:`AlignedField.refused`; the rest are still aligned, so one lost cycle does not cost the field.
records.translation: Hver basarás er fyrst færð á fyrstu rás síns hrings, eftir klipptum frumubakgrunni sem rásirnar deila -- á mældu plötunni lágu þær allt að 14 px hvor frá annarri, sem engin skráning milli hringja sér -- og síðan er hver hringur færður á viðmiðunina með :func:`sbs_mean_target`. Hringur sem er boðinn sem ``None`` eða með vantandi flöt er skráður í :attr:`AlignedField.missing` og hringur sem fékk skráningu hafnað í :attr:`AlignedField.refused`; hinir eru samt jafnaðir, svo einn tapaður hringur kostar ekki sviðið.

records.context: ``cycle -> the base channels of that cycle``, every image layer one 2-D image of the same shape.
records.label: spacr.ops_cycles.align_field#2

records.translation: ``cycle -> the base channels of that cycle``, þar sem hver flötur er 2-D mynd af sömu lögun.

records.context: the cycle everything is moved onto. None takes the lowest cycle that has image layers.
records.label: spacr.ops_cycles.align_field#3
records.source: the cycle everything is moved onto. None takes the lowest cycle that has planes.
records.translation: hringurinn sem allt er fært á. None tekur lægsta hringinn sem hefur fleti.

records.translation: leyfir fasafylgninni að keyra á skjákortinu.

records.context: the aligned field.

records.source: the aligned field.

records.context: Run an optical pooled screening experiment's sequencing acquisition from microscope image fields to tables.
records.label: spacr.ops_engine#0
records.source: Run an optical pooled screen's sequencing acquisition from tiles to tables.
records.translation: Keyrir raðgreiningartöku ljósfræðilegrar samsafnaðrar skimunar frá flísum til taflna.

records.context: One call takes each microplate sample position from its microscope image field files to three tables in ``measurements.db``: ``ops_geometry``, where each nuclear microscope image field sits in the microplate sample position frame; ``ops_objects``, one row per nucleus, segmented on the composed nuclear map and numbered once for the microplate sample position; and ``ops_barcodes``, one row per nucleus whose attributed reads agree.
records.label: spacr.ops_engine#1
records.source: One call takes each well from its tile files to three tables in ``measurements.db``: ``ops_geometry``, where each nuclear tile sits in the well frame; ``ops_objects``, one row per nucleus, segmented on the composed nuclear map and numbered once for the well; and ``ops_barcodes``, one row per nucleus whose attributed reads agree.
records.translation: Eitt kall færir hvern brunn frá flísaskrám sínum í þrjár töflur í ``measurements.db``: ``ops_geometry``, hvar hver kjarnaflís liggur í hnitakerfi brunnsins; ``ops_objects``, ein röð á hvern kjarna, skiptan á samsettu kjarnakortinu og númeraðan einu sinni fyrir brunninn; og ``ops_barcodes``, ein röð á hvern kjarna sem úthlutaðir lestrar eru sammála um.

records.context: half a microscope image field's side, in grid units. A site is kept when its whole microscope image field lies inside the circle: at ``(dx, dy)`` from the centre, when ``(|dx| + half_tile)**2 + (|dy| + half_tile)**2 <= radius**2``. Zero keeps every site whose centre is inside, which is the rule every layout followed before this microscope field of view existed.
records.label: spacr.ops_layout.WellLayout#5
records.source: half a tile's side, in grid units. A site is kept when its whole tile lies inside the circle: at ``(dx, dy)`` from the centre, when ``(|dx| + half_tile)**2 + (|dy| + half_tile)**2 <= radius**2``. Zero keeps every site whose centre is inside, which is the rule every layout followed before this field existed.
records.translation: helmingur af hlið flísar, í grindareiningum. Staður er geymdur þegar öll flís hans liggur innan hringsins: í ``(dx, dy)`` frá miðju, þegar ``(|dx| + half_tile)**2 + (|dy| + half_tile)**2 <= radius**2``. Núll geymir hvern stað sem hefur miðju innan hringsins, sem er reglan sem hver uppsetning fylgdi áður en þetta svið varð til.

records.context: The microscope image field has to fit, not its centre. The centre rule holds the 333-microscope field of view sequencing well and cannot produce the column heights the 1,281-microscope field of view phenotype well was measured at, for any radius. With the footprint term both come out as measured, and every column is centred on the same row.
records.label: spacr.ops_layout.WellLayout#6
records.source: The tile has to fit, not its centre. The centre rule holds the 333-field sequencing well and cannot produce the column heights the 1,281-field phenotype well was measured at, for any radius. With the footprint term both come out as measured, and every column is centred on the same row.
records.translation: Flísin þarf að rúmast, ekki bara miðja hennar. Miðjureglan nær raðgreiningarbrunninum með 333 sviðum en getur ekki, við neinn geisla, gefið dálkahæðirnar sem svipgerðarbrunnurinn með 1,281 sviði var mældur með. Með fótsporsliðnum koma báðir út eins og mælt var, og hver dálkur er miðjaður á sömu röð.

records.context: the inclusive absolute row range of the sites whose whole microscope image field lies inside the circle -- see :attr:`half_tile`.
records.label: spacr.ops_layout.WellLayout.span#2
records.source: the inclusive absolute row range of the sites whose whole tile lies inside the circle -- see :attr:`half_tile`.
records.translation: algilt raðasvið, með endapunktum, fyrir þá staði þar sem öll flísin liggur innan hringsins -- sjá :attr:`half_tile`.

records.context: The measured well is returned unchanged whenever the search lands on its 333 sites, so the confirmed model is never re-derived. For any other count the radius is searched -- a well imaged at a different magnification or a different laboratory microplate format is the same circle with a different number of microscope fields of view in it.
records.label: spacr.ops_layout.round_well_layout#1
records.source: The measured well is returned unchanged whenever the search lands on its 333 sites, so the confirmed model is never re-derived. For any other count the radius is searched -- a well imaged at a different magnification or a different plate format is the same circle with a different number of fields in it.
records.translation: Mældi brunnurinn er skilaður óbreyttur í hvert sinn sem leitin lendir á 333 stöðum hans, svo staðfesta líkanið er aldrei leitt út aftur. Fyrir hvern annan fjölda er leitað að geislanum -- brunnur sem tekinn er með annarri stækkun eða á öðru plötusniði er sami hringurinn með öðrum fjölda sviða innan í sér.

records.context: half a microscope image field's side in microscope image field pitches -- the microscope image field size over twice the registered pitch. A microscope field of view is kept when its whole microscope image field lies inside the circle; zero keeps it when its centre does. The default is the phenotype acquisition's measured 0.5857. The sequencing acquisition measured 0.5840, and every value strictly between 0.5 and 2.0 gives both microplate sample positions -- 333 and 1,281 microscope fields of view -- the column heights they were measured at.
records.label: spacr.ops_layout.round_well_layout#4
records.source: half a tile's side in tile pitches -- the tile size over twice the registered pitch. A field is kept when its whole tile lies inside the circle; zero keeps it when its centre does. The default is the phenotype acquisition's measured 0.5857. The sequencing acquisition measured 0.5840, and every value strictly between 0.5 and 2.0 gives both wells -- 333 and 1,281 fields -- the column heights they were measured at.
records.translation: helmingur af hlið flísar í flísabilum -- stærð flísarinnar deilt með tvöföldu skráðu bili. Svið er geymt þegar öll flís þess liggur innan hringsins; núll geymir það þegar miðja þess gerir það. Sjálfgefið gildi er mælda gildi svipgerðartökunnar, 0.5857. Raðgreiningartakan mældist 0.5840, og hvert gildi stranglega milli 0.5 og 2.0 gefur báðum brunnunum -- 333 og 1,281 sviði -- þær dálkahæðir sem þeir voru mældir með.

records.context: when no circle holds exactly that many microscope fields of view, which is the honest answer -- a count that no round well produces means the acquisition is not one, and guessing the nearest would place every microscope image field slightly wrong. Also when ``half_tile`` is negative or not a number.
records.label: spacr.ops_layout.round_well_layout#6
records.source: when no circle holds exactly that many fields, which is the honest answer -- a count that no round well produces means the acquisition is not one, and guessing the nearest would place every tile slightly wrong. Also when ``half_tile`` is negative or not a number.
records.translation: þegar enginn hringur rúmar nákvæmlega svo mörg svið, sem er heiðarlega svarið -- fjöldi sem enginn kringlóttur brunnur gefur þýðir að takan er ekki slíkur brunnur, og að giska á þann næsta myndi setja hverja flís örlítið rangt. Einnig þegar ``half_tile`` er neikvætt eða ekki tala.

records.context: For one half microscope image field, the count fixes the fields. The number of fields inside the circle only grows with the radius, so every radius that holds exactly ``site_count`` holds the same ones. The radius the layout carries is one of those, not a measurement.
records.label: spacr.ops_layout.round_well_layout#7
records.source: For one half tile, the count fixes the fields. The number of fields inside the circle only grows with the radius, so every radius that holds exactly ``site_count`` holds the same ones. The radius the layout carries is one of those, not a measurement.
records.translation: Fyrir tiltekna hálfa flís ákvarðar fjöldinn sviðin. Fjöldi sviða innan hringsins vex aðeins með geislanum, svo hver geisli sem rúmar nákvæmlega ``site_count`` rúmar sömu sviðin. Geislinn sem uppsetningin ber er einn af þeim, ekki mæling.

records.context: Which leaves one failure that must not be silent: an object larger than the overlap, which every window clips. :func:`number` refuses those rather than emitting a fragment, because a fragment looks exactly like a small nucleus and would be counted as one for the rest of the processing session.
records.label: spacr.ops_objects#7
records.source: WHICH LEAVES ONE FAILURE THAT MUST NOT BE SILENT: an object larger than the overlap, which every window clips. :func:`number` refuses those rather than emitting a fragment, because a fragment looks exactly like a small nucleus and would be counted as one for the rest of the run.
records.translation: WHICH LEAVES ONE FAILURE THAT MUST NOT BE SILENT (sem skilur eftir eina villu sem má ekki vera þögul): hlutur stærri en skörunin, sem hver gluggi klippir. :func:`number` hafnar slíkum í stað þess að skila broti, því brot lítur nákvæmlega út eins og lítill kjarni og yrði talið sem einn það sem eftir er keyrslunnar.

records.context: refuse a group with no complete observation. Turned off, such a group is dropped rather than numbered -- nothing with a truncated area is emitted -- and how many were dropped is logged as a warning.
records.label: spacr.ops_objects.number#4
records.source: refuse a group with no complete observation. Turned off, such a group is dropped rather than numbered -- nothing with a truncated area is emitted -- and how many were dropped is logged as a warning.
records.translation: hafna hópi án fullkominnar athugunar. Sé slökkt á því er slíkum hópi fleygt í stað þess að hann sé númeraður -- ekkert með stýft flatarmál er gefið út -- og fjöldi þeirra sem var fleygt er skráður sem viðvörun.

records.context: when a group holds only clipped observations: either the object is larger than the window overlap, or it is a fragment that matched no window's whole view of its nucleus. The message gives the object's extent and the remedy for each case.
records.label: spacr.ops_objects.number#5
records.source: when a group holds only clipped observations: either the object is larger than the window overlap, or it is a fragment that matched no window's whole view of its nucleus. The message gives the object's extent and the remedy for each case.
records.translation: þegar hópur inniheldur aðeins klipptar athuganir: annaðhvort er hluturinn stærri en skörun glugganna, eða hann er brot sem passaði ekki við heila sýn neins glugga á kjarna sinn. Skilaboðin gefa umfang hlutarins og úrræði fyrir hvort tilvik.

records.context: Two labels of one window are never one object, because a label image does not give one nucleus two labels. Two complete observations from different windows are one nucleus when their centroids agree within ``tolerance`` on each axis and either their areas agree to ``area_ratio`` or their centroids lie within the smaller one's equivalent radius -- the radius of a disc of its area. Pairs whose areas agree are joined first, then the rest closest first, and a join that would give a group two labels of one window is refused.
records.label: spacr.ops_objects.sew#3
records.source: Two labels of one window are never one object, because a label image does not give one nucleus two labels. Two complete observations from different windows are one nucleus when their centroids agree within ``tolerance`` on each axis and either their areas agree to ``area_ratio`` or their centroids lie within the smaller one's equivalent radius -- the radius of a disc of its area. Pairs whose areas agree are joined first, then the rest closest first, and a join that would give a group two labels of one window is refused.
records.translation: Tvö merki sama glugga eru aldrei einn hlutur, því merkjamynd gefur ekki einum kjarna tvö merki. Tvær fullkomnar athuganir úr ólíkum gluggum eru einn kjarni þegar massamiðjur þeirra passa innan ``tolerance`` á hvorum ási og annaðhvort passa flatarmál þeirra upp að ``area_ratio`` eða massamiðjurnar liggja innan jafngildisgeisla þeirrar minni -- geisla skífu með flatarmáli hennar. Pör með samsvarandi flatarmál eru sameinuð fyrst, síðan hin, þau nánustu fyrst, og sameiningu sem gæfi hópi tvö merki úr einum glugga er hafnað.

records.context: A clipped observation is matched by containment, not by a fixed distance: the cut moves its centroid inward by up to the nucleus's radius, so a fixed tolerance misses exactly the deep clips. It joins a complete observation from another window when its centroid lies inside that observation's equivalent disc, or its bounding box lies inside that observation's box give or take two pixels. It joins only the closest such observation, so one clip can never make two nuclei one object. Clipped observations that match nothing complete are grouped with each other where their boxes overlap.
records.label: spacr.ops_objects.sew#4
records.source: A clipped observation is matched by containment, not by a fixed distance: the cut moves its centroid inward by up to the nucleus's radius, so a fixed tolerance misses exactly the deep clips. It joins a complete observation from another window when its centroid lies inside that observation's equivalent disc, or its bounding box lies inside that observation's box give or take two pixels. It joins only the closest such observation, so one clip can never make two nuclei one object. Clipped observations that match nothing complete are grouped with each other where their boxes overlap.
records.translation: Klippt athugun er pöruð eftir innihaldi, ekki eftir föstu bili: klippingin færir massamiðju hennar inn á við um allt að geisla kjarnans, svo fast þol missir einmitt af djúpu klippunum. Hún sameinast fullkominni athugun úr öðrum glugga þegar massamiðja hennar liggur innan jafngildisskífu þeirrar athugunar, eða þegar afmörkunarrammi hennar liggur innan ramma þeirrar athugunar með tveggja díla skekkju. Hún sameinast aðeins þeirri nánustu slíkri athugun, svo eitt klipp getur aldrei gert tvo kjarna að einum hlut. Klipptar athuganir sem passa ekki við neitt fullkomið eru hópaðar saman þar sem rammar þeirra skarast.

records.context: Where every phenotype field's centre lies, from a few measured ones.
records.label: spacr.ops_phenotype.phenotype_centres#0
records.source: Where every phenotype field's centre lies, from a few measured ones.
records.translation: Hvar miðja hvers svipgerðarsviðs liggur, út frá nokkrum mældum.

records.context: the phenotype acquisition's :class:`spacr.ops_layout.WellLayout`, or how many microscope fields of view it holds.
records.label: spacr.ops_phenotype.phenotype_centres#1
records.source: the phenotype acquisition's :class:`spacr.ops_layout.WellLayout`, or how many fields it holds.
records.translation: :class:`spacr.ops_layout.WellLayout` svipgerðartökunnar, eða hve mörg svið hún geymir.

records.context: ``{site: (y, x)}``, the microplate sample position-frame centres of at least three aligned microscope fields of view whose grid positions are not all on one line. Six spread over the microplate sample position is what the method was validated with.
records.label: spacr.ops_phenotype.phenotype_centres#2
records.source: ``{site: (y, x)}``, the well-frame centres of at least three aligned fields whose grid positions are not all on one line. Six spread over the well is what the method was validated with.
records.translation: ``{site: (y, x)}``, miðjur í hnitakerfi brunnsins fyrir minnst þrjú jöfnuð svið sem hafa grindarstöður sem liggja ekki allar á einni línu. Aðferðin var sannprófuð með sex dreifðum um brunninn.

records.context: ``{site: (y, x)}`` for every field of the layout, anchors included -- their fitted centres, not the measured ones.
records.label: spacr.ops_phenotype.phenotype_centres#3
records.source: ``{site: (y, x)}`` for every field of the layout, anchors included -- their fitted centres, not the measured ones.
records.translation: ``{site: (y, x)}`` fyrir hvert svið uppsetningarinnar, festupunktar meðtaldir -- aðlagaðar miðjur þeirra, ekki þær mældu.

records.context: when the anchors cannot fix a raster: fewer than three, on one line of the grid, or a centre that is not two finite numbers. Also for a microscope field of view count no round well holds.
records.label: spacr.ops_phenotype.phenotype_centres#4
records.source: when the anchors cannot fix a raster: fewer than three, on one line of the grid, or a centre that is not two finite numbers. Also for a field count no round well holds.
records.translation: þegar festupunktarnir geta ekki fest grind: færri en þrír, á einni línu grindarinnar, eða miðja sem er ekki tvær endanlegar tölur. Einnig fyrir sviðafjölda sem enginn kringlóttur brunnur rúmar.

records.context: when an anchor names a site the layout does not hold.
records.label: spacr.ops_phenotype.phenotype_centres#5
records.source: when an anchor names a site the layout does not hold.
records.translation: þegar festupunktur nefnir stað sem uppsetningin geymir ekki.

records.context: Six numbers place the whole well. The layout gives every microscope field of view's grid position, and the acquisition raster maps a grid position into the well frame by an origin, a column step and a row step, each a ``(dy, dx)`` pair carrying the stage's few pixels of skew. Fitted by least squares on six microscope fields of view of a real well, that predicted the other 472 microscope fields of view' measured centres to a median 1.2 px and a worst 4.0 px, and a second well's 451 to a worst 4.4 px.
records.label: spacr.ops_phenotype.phenotype_centres#6
records.source: Six numbers place the whole well. The layout gives every field's grid position, and the acquisition raster maps a grid position into the well frame by an origin, a column step and a row step, each a ``(dy, dx)`` pair carrying the stage's few pixels of skew. Fitted by least squares on six fields of a real well, that predicted the other 472 fields' measured centres to a median 1.2 px and a worst 4.0 px, and a second well's 451 to a worst 4.4 px.
records.translation: Sex tölur staðsetja allan brunninn. Uppsetningin gefur grindarstöðu hvers sviðs, og tökugrindin varpar grindarstöðu í hnitakerfi brunnsins með upphafspunkti, dálkaskrefi og raðaskrefi, hvert þeirra ``(dy, dx)`` par sem ber fáeina díla af halla borðsins. Aðlagað með minnstu kvaðrötum á sex sviðum raunverulegs brunns spáði það fyrir um mældar miðjur hinna 472 sviðanna með miðgildi 1.2 px og mest 4.0 px, og 451 sviða annars brunns með mest 4.4 px.

records.label: spacr.ops_phenotype.phenotype_site_map#0
records.source: Which sequencing tile covers each phenotype field.
records.translation: Hvaða raðgreiningarflís þekur hvert svipgerðarsvið.

records.label: spacr.ops_phenotype.phenotype_site_map#1

records.context: ``{phenotype site: (y, x)}``, measured well-frame centres of at least three aligned phenotype microscope fields of view, as :func:`phenotype_centres` takes them.
records.label: spacr.ops_phenotype.phenotype_site_map#3
records.source: ``{phenotype site: (y, x)}``, measured well-frame centres of at least three aligned phenotype fields, as :func:`phenotype_centres` takes them.
records.translation: ``{phenotype site: (y, x)}``, mældar miðjur í hnitakerfi brunnsins fyrir minnst þrjú jöfnuð svipgerðarsvið, eins og :func:`phenotype_centres` tekur við þeim.

records.context: ``(height, width)`` of a sequencing microscope image field, in well-frame pixels.
records.label: spacr.ops_phenotype.phenotype_site_map#4
records.source: ``(height, width)`` of a sequencing tile, in well-frame pixels.
records.translation: ``(height, width)`` raðgreiningarflísar, í dílum hnitakerfis brunnsins.

records.context: ``{phenotype site: sequencing site}``. Each microscope field of view goes to the tile whose centre is nearest its predicted centre, among the tiles that contain it; a microscope field of view whose predicted centre lies inside no tile is omitted.
records.label: spacr.ops_phenotype.phenotype_site_map#5
records.source: ``{phenotype site: sequencing site}``. Each field goes to the tile whose centre is nearest its predicted centre, among the tiles that contain it; a field whose predicted centre lies inside no tile is omitted.
records.translation: ``{phenotype site: sequencing site}``. Hvert svið fer á þá flís sem hefur miðju næst spáðri miðju þess, á meðal flísanna sem innihalda það; sviði sem hefur spáða miðju utan allra flísa er sleppt.

records.context: when ``tile_shape`` is not two positive sizes, or when :func:`phenotype_centres` refuses the anchors or the count.
records.label: spacr.ops_phenotype.phenotype_site_map#6
records.source: when ``tile_shape`` is not two positive sizes, or when :func:`phenotype_centres` refuses the anchors or the count.
records.translation: þegar ``tile_shape`` er ekki tvær jákvæðar stærðir, eða þegar :func:`phenotype_centres` hafnar festupunktunum eða fjöldanum.

records.context: A position, not an index. The microscope image field a microscope field of view lies on depends on where the microscope image field boundaries actually fall, and halving a phenotype grid index about the microplate sample position centre cannot see them: at twice the microscope image field density half the phenotype microscope fields of view lie on or near a sequencing microscope image field boundary. On the real laboratory microplate halving found the exact microscope image field for 0.45 to 0.61 of the aligned microscope fields of view; predicting each centre from six anchors and taking the nearest stitched microscope image field found it for 472 of 472 and 451 of 451.
records.label: spacr.ops_phenotype.phenotype_site_map#7
records.source: A position, not an index. The tile a field lies on depends on where the tile boundaries actually fall, and halving a phenotype grid index about the well centre cannot see them: at twice the tile density half the phenotype fields lie on or near a sequencing tile boundary. On the real plate halving found the exact tile for 0.45 to 0.61 of the aligned fields; predicting each centre from six anchors and taking the nearest stitched tile found it for 472 of 472 and 451 of 451.
records.translation: Staðsetning, ekki vísir. Á hvaða flís svið liggur ræðst af því hvar flísamörkin falla í raun, og að helminga grindarvísi svipgerðar um miðju brunnsins getur ekki séð þau: við tvöfaldan flísaþéttleika liggur helmingur svipgerðarsviðanna á eða nálægt raðgreiningarflísamörkum. Á raunverulegu plötunni fann helmingunin réttu flísina fyrir 0.45 til 0.61 af jöfnuðu sviðunum; að spá hverri miðju út frá sex festupunktum og taka næstu samsaumuðu flísina fann hana fyrir 472 af 472 og 451 af 451.

records.context: Delegates the call itself to :func:`spacr.ops_sbs.call_reads`, which already normalises each cycle's channels and reports quality as the MINIMUM over cycles -- "a barcode is only as trustworthy as its worst base". Repeating that here would be a second decoder to keep in step.
records.label: spacr.ops_sample.barcode_rows#1
records.source: Delegates the call itself to :func:`spacr.ops_sbs.call_reads`, which already normalises each cycle's channels and reports quality as the MINIMUM over cycles -- "a barcode is only as trustworthy as its worst base". Repeating that here would be a second decoder to keep in step.
records.translation: Felur :func:`spacr.ops_sbs.call_reads` sjálft kallið, sem staðlar þegar rásir hvers hrings og skilar gæðunum sem MINIMUM (lágmarki) yfir hringina -- "strikamerki er aðeins jafn áreiðanlegt og versti basi þess". Að endurtaka það hér væri annar afkóðari sem þyrfti að halda í takt.

records.context: Optical pooled screening reads the guide barcode out of the images. Each sequencing cycle stains four image data channels, one per base, and a spot's base in that cycle is whichever image data channel is brightest -- once the image data channels have been put on a common scale. Read one base per cycle at the same spot and the cycles spell the barcode.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs#2
records.source: Optical pooled screening reads the guide barcode OUT OF THE IMAGES. Each sequencing cycle stains four channels, one per base, and a spot's base in that cycle is whichever channel is brightest -- once the channels have been put on a common scale. Read one base per cycle at the same spot and the cycles spell the barcode.
records.translation: Ljósfræðileg samsöfnuð skimun les strikamerki leiðarans OUT OF THE IMAGES (beint úr myndunum). Hver raðgreiningarhringur litar fjórar rásir, eina fyrir hvern basa, og basi bletts í þeim hring er sú rás sem er björtust -- þegar rásirnar hafa verið færðar á sameiginlegan kvarða. Lestu einn basa í hverjum hring á sama blettinum og hringirnir stafa strikamerkið.

records.context: **The brightest raw channel is not the base.** Every channel has its own gain and background, and on a real plate both drift from cycle to cycle, so the raw argmax is biased toward whichever channel is brightest overall. Each cycle's channels are divided by their median over the reads first. Unmixing the dyes' bleed-through is available on top of that; on the first real plate it lowered the library match.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs#7
records.source: **The brightest raw channel is not the base.** Every channel has its own gain and background, and on a real plate both drift from cycle to cycle, so the raw argmax is biased toward whichever channel is brightest overall. Each cycle's channels are divided by their median over the reads first. Unmixing the dyes' bleed-through is available on top of that; on the first real plate it lowered the library match.
records.translation: **Bjartasta hráa rásin er ekki basinn.** Hver rás hefur sína eigin mögnun og bakgrunn, og á raunverulegri plötu reka hvort tveggja milli hringja, svo hrátt argmax hallast að þeirri rás sem er björtust í heild. Rásir hvers hrings eru fyrst deildar með miðgildi sínu yfir lestrana. Ofan á það er hægt að greina í sundur leka milli litarefna; á fyrstu raunverulegu plötunni lækkaði það samsvörun við safnið.

records.context: Give each laboratory microplate object the barcode its attributed reads agree on.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.assign_reads_to_objects#0
records.source: Give each plate object the barcode its attributed reads agree on.
records.translation: Gefur hverjum plötuhlut það strikamerki sem úthlutaðir lestrar hans eru sammála um.

records.context: The same rule as :func:`assign_reads_to_cells` -- at least ``min_reads`` reads, ``min_fraction`` of them carrying one barcode, and no tie for first -- keyed by the object id each read was attributed to rather than by the label a read lands on. That is what lets reads collected from several microscope fields of view vote once for the object they belong to.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.assign_reads_to_objects#1
records.source: The same rule as :func:`assign_reads_to_cells` -- at least ``min_reads`` reads, ``min_fraction`` of them carrying one barcode, and no tie for first -- keyed by the object id each read was attributed to rather than by the label a read lands on. That is what lets reads collected from several fields vote once for the object they belong to.
records.translation: Sama regla og :func:`assign_reads_to_cells` -- minnst ``min_reads`` lestrar, þar af ``min_fraction`` með sama strikamerki, og ekkert jafntefli um fyrsta sætið -- en lyklað eftir auðkenni hlutarins sem hverjum lestri var úthlutað til, ekki eftir merkinu sem lesturinn lendir á. Það er það sem gerir lestrum frá mörgum sviðum kleift að kjósa einu sinni fyrir hlutinn sem þeir tilheyra.

records.context: one object id per read; 0 or a negative id means the read has no owner and is ignored.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.assign_reads_to_objects#2
records.source: one object id per read; 0 or a negative id means the read has no owner and is ignored.
records.translation: eitt auðkenni hlutar á hvern lestur; 0 eða neikvætt auðkenni þýðir að lesturinn á engan eiganda og er hunsaður.

records.context: one called barcode per read.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.assign_reads_to_objects#3
records.source: one called barcode per read.
records.translation: eitt lesið strikamerki á hvern lestur.

records.context: optional per-read quality from :func:`call_reads`.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.assign_reads_to_objects#4
records.source: optional per-read quality from :func:`call_reads`.
records.translation: valfrjáls gæði hvers lesturs úr :func:`call_reads`.

records.context: how many reads an object needs before it may be assigned.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.assign_reads_to_objects#5
records.source: how many reads an object needs before it may be assigned.
records.translation: hve marga lestra hlutur þarf áður en honum má úthluta.

records.context: what share of them must agree.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.assign_reads_to_objects#6
records.source: what share of them must agree.
records.translation: hve stór hluti þeirra þarf að vera sammála.

records.context: ``{object_id: {"barcode", "reads", "agreeing", "fraction", "quality"}}`` for every object that met the bar.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.assign_reads_to_objects#7
records.source: ``{object_id: {"barcode", "reads", "agreeing", "fraction", "quality"}}`` for every object that met the bar.
records.translation: ``{object_id: {"barcode", "reads", "agreeing", "fraction", "quality"}}`` fyrir hvern hlut sem náði markinu.

records.context: Give each detected read to the object whose boundary is nearest.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.attribute_reads#0
records.source: Give each detected read to the object whose boundary is nearest.
records.translation: Úthlutar hverjum greindum lestri til þess hlutar sem hefur næst mörk.

records.context: Reads are detected over the whole field first and attributed here, so a footprint that is too tight shows up as reads with no owner rather than staying invisible. The boundary is each object's equivalent disc, the circle of its area about its centroid, and a read whose two nearest boundaries lie within ``tie`` of each other is given to neither and flagged.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.attribute_reads#1
records.source: Reads are detected over the whole field first and attributed here, so a footprint that is too tight shows up as reads with no owner rather than staying invisible. The boundary is each object's equivalent disc, the circle of its area about its centroid, and a read whose two nearest boundaries lie within ``tie`` of each other is given to neither and flagged.
records.translation: Lestrar eru fyrst greindir yfir allt sviðið og þeim úthlutað hér, svo of þröngt fótspor sést sem lestrar án eiganda í stað þess að haldast ósýnilegt. Mörkin eru jafngildisskífa hvers hlutar, hringurinn með flatarmáli hans um massamiðju hans, og lestur þar sem tvö næstu mörkin liggja innan ``tie`` hvort frá öðru er ekki úthlutaður neinum og merktur.

records.context: ``(N, 2)`` read positions ``(y, x)``.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.attribute_reads#2
records.source: ``(N, 2)`` read positions ``(y, x)``.
records.translation: ``(N, 2)`` staðsetningar lestra ``(y, x)``.

records.context: ``(M, 2)`` object centroids ``(y, x)``, in the same frame as ``peaks``.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.attribute_reads#3
records.source: ``(M, 2)`` object centroids ``(y, x)``, in the same frame as ``peaks``.
records.translation: ``(M, 2)`` massamiðjur hluta ``(y, x)``, í sama hnitakerfi og ``peaks``.

records.context: ``(M,)`` object areas in pixels.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.attribute_reads#4
records.source: ``(M,)`` object areas in pixels.
records.translation: ``(M,)`` flatarmál hluta í dílum.

records.context: how far beyond an object's boundary a read may lie and still be its read, in pixels. On the first real plate 98 % of spots lay within 10 px of a nucleus and 67 % within 3 px.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.attribute_reads#5
records.source: how far beyond an object's boundary a read may lie and still be its read, in pixels. On the first real plate 98 % of spots lay within 10 px of a nucleus and 67 % within 3 px.
records.translation: hve langt utan við mörk hlutar lestur má liggja og samt teljast lestur hans, í dílum. Á fyrstu raunverulegu plötunni lágu 98 % bletta innan 10 px frá kjarna og 67 % innan 3 px.

records.context: how close the two nearest boundaries may be before a read is refused as ambiguous, in pixels.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.attribute_reads#6
records.source: how close the two nearest boundaries may be before a read is refused as ambiguous, in pixels.
records.translation: hve nálægt hvort öðru tvö næstu mörkin mega vera áður en lestri er hafnað sem tvíræðum, í dílum.

records.context: ``(owner, ambiguous)`` -- the index into ``centroids`` of each read's owner, or -1, and whether each read was refused as ambiguous.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.attribute_reads#7
records.source: ``(owner, ambiguous)`` -- the index into ``centroids`` of each read's owner, or -1, and whether each read was refused as ambiguous.
records.translation: ``(owner, ambiguous)`` -- vísirinn í ``centroids`` fyrir eiganda hvers lesturs, eða -1, og hvort hverjum lestri var hafnað sem tvíræðum.

records.context: A cycle that was not measured is called ``N``. Where a read's values for one cycle are NaN -- the cycle's file could not be read, or its registration was refused -- that letter is ``N`` and the quality is taken over the cycles that were measured, so one lost cycle costs one base of each read and not the read.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.call_reads#2
records.source: A cycle that was not measured is called ``N``. Where a read's values for one cycle are NaN -- the cycle's file could not be read, or its registration was refused -- that letter is ``N`` and the quality is taken over the cycles that were measured, so one lost cycle costs one base of each read and not the read.
records.translation: Hringur sem var ekki mældur er kallaður ``N``. Þar sem gildi lesturs í einum hring eru NaN -- ekki tókst að lesa skrá hringsins eða skráningu hans var hafnað -- er sá stafur ``N`` og gæðin eru reiknuð yfir þá hringi sem voru mældir, þannig að einn tapaður hringur kostar einn basa í hverjum lestri en ekki lesturinn allan.

records.context: undo cross-talk with :func:`compensate_crosstalk` after normalising. Off by default: on the first real plate it lowered the library match.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.call_reads#5
records.source: undo cross-talk with :func:`compensate_crosstalk` after normalising. Off by default: on the first real plate it lowered the library match.
records.translation: afturkallar víxlhrif með :func:`compensate_crosstalk` eftir stöðlun. Slökkt sjálfgefið: á fyrstu raunverulegu plötunni lækkaði það samsvörun við safnið.

records.context: divide each cycle's channels by their median over the reads first, which removes the per-channel gain and background drift between cycles. Skipped when there are too few reads for a median.

records.source: divide each cycle's channels by their median over the reads first, which removes the per-channel gain and background drift between cycles. Skipped when there are too few reads for a median.
records.translation: deilir fyrst rásum hvers hrings með miðgildi þeirra yfir lestrana, sem fjarlægir rek í mögnun og bakgrunni hverrar rásar milli hringja. Sleppt þegar lestrarnir eru of fáir fyrir miðgildi.

records.context: An ``N`` is a base that was not measured, not a mismatch. It matches any letter and is not counted against ``max_distance``; the uniqueness rule still applies, so a read whose lost base is the only thing separating two guides maps to neither.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.correct_to_library#3
records.source: An ``N`` is a base that was not measured, not a mismatch. It matches any letter and is not counted against ``max_distance``; the uniqueness rule still applies, so a read whose lost base is the only thing separating two guides maps to neither.
records.translation: ``N`` er basi sem var ekki mældur, ekki misræmi. Hann passar við hvaða staf sem er og telst ekki með í ``max_distance``; einkvæmnireglan gildir samt, svo lestur þar sem tapaði basinn er það eina sem skilur tvo leiðara að er ekki tengdur við hvorugan.

records.context: on an unknown table; when the sidecar it just wrote does not have the same number of rows as the database; or when ``ops_objects`` or ``ops_barcodes`` would hold two rows for one object, inside the frame or between the frame and the table it is appended to. records.label: spacr.ops_store.write_table#6
records.source: on an unknown table; when the sidecar it just wrote does not have the same number of rows as the database; or when ``ops_objects`` or ``ops_barcodes`` would hold two rows for one object, inside the frame or between the frame and the table it is appended to. One row per object is a UNIQUE constraint in the schema, and nothing is written when it would be broken.
records.translation: við óþekkta töflu; þegar hliðarskráin sem var rétt skrifuð hefur ekki sama fjölda raða og gagnagrunnurinn; eða þegar ``ops_objects`` eða ``ops_barcodes`` myndu geyma tvær raðir fyrir einn hlut, innan gagnarammans eða milli gagnarammans og töflunnar sem honum er bætt við. Ein röð á hlut er UNIQUE skorða í skemanu, og ekkert er skrifað þegar hún yrði brotin.
